title: Edge colourings and Ramsey numbers
proposed_reference_coverage: **Edge colourings and Ramsey numbers: monochromatic complete subgraphs**
fact_or_context_to_reference: Unordered pairs are graph edges, and a pair-homogeneous set is a monochromatic complete subgraph. The six-point/two-colour triangle theorem and the five-cycle counterexample use these notions explicitly.
